findings.problem: ‘ऑटो-पुश’ (Devanagari transliteration) is the only occurrence of that spelling in the whole hi locale; the other eight occurrences of the same term inside this catalogue use the Latin form ‘ऑटो-push’ (auto_push, enable, enable_title, enable_public, healthy, healthy_unsourced, auto_push_unverified, auto_push_source_unknown).
findings.fix: Use ‘ऑटो-push’ here so the term matches everywhere else in hi.

findings.problem: Rendered ‘अद्यतित’ (a rare literary form) for the same English “up to date” that ui.hub.links.mark_healthy renders as ‘अपडेट है’; the register also sits apart from the catalogue’s conversational Hindi.
findings.fix: Use one form in both keys, e.g. ‘अपडेट है’ or ‘अद्यतन’.
